tools.description: Boots every map (or config smoke.maps) in -game -nullrhi for a fixed time and gates on fatal, crash, ensure and error counts.
tools.invocation: UnrealEditor-Cmd <uproject> <map> -game -nullrhi -nosound -unattended -log -ABSLOG=<file>, stopped after smoke.seconds; logs parsed by lens_logs

tools.description: Captures N frames with the CSV profiler on one map and reports FrameTime / thread time percentiles, hitches and a frame-time series against a budget.
tools.invocation: UnrealEditor <uproject> <map> -game -windowed -csvCompression=0 -ExitAfterCsvProfiling -ExecCmds="csvprofile startfile=<id>.csv,csvprofile exitoncompletion,csvprofile frames=N"; Saved/Profiling/CSV parsed by lens_runtime.py

tools.description: Content size by asset, folder and file type, plus hard-reference load weight per asset from the latest analyze graph. No engine needed.
tools.invocation: scans Content/*.uasset|umap|uexp|ubulk; closure over AssetHardRef edges in graph.json

tools.description: Records an Unreal Insights trace of the running game for a fixed time.
tools.invocation: UnrealEditor <uproject> <map> -game -trace=<trace.channels> -tracefile=<run>/out/trace.utrace -statnamedevents, closed after trace.seconds

tools.description: Starts the game detached (windowed 1280x720) and prints its pid; used by the GUI to stream to the StateMonitor viewer.
tools.invocation: UnrealEditor <uproject> [map] -game -windowed -ResX=1280 -ResY=720 -log (Start-Process, returns immediately)
UnrealInsights -OpenTraceFile=<utrace> -unattended -autoquit -noui -ExecOnAnalysisCompleteCmd="TimingInsights.ExportTimerStatistics <csv>"
UnrealEditor-Cmd -run=SummarizeTrace -inputfile=<utrace>
Engine/Binaries/DotNET/CsvTools/PerfreportTool -csv <perf.csv> -o <out> (HTML report on top of the perf line)
UBT <Target> Win64 Development -StaticAnalyzer=VisualCpp (nightly, code projects only)
UBT -Mode=IWYU -NoCompile (report only, never -Write)
